prompt:
Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "🌾 Sprechi alimentari e sostenibilità", solid fill #558B2F, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Sprechi alimentari e sostenibilità"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente analizza il sistema alimentare…" | "dati globali e domestici" | "studente" | "comprende"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "imballaggio alimentare / food packaging" | "over-packaging / over-packaging"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Monitora gli sprechi alimentari in casa per una…" | "pesa o stima il cibo buttato ogni giorno,…" | "Professione futura: Food Technologist / Nutrizionista Industriale"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "spreco alimentare" | "sostenibilità" | "food waste" | "impatto ambientale" | "imballaggio alimentare"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #558B2F on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
